Supreme Court Task Force Studies Student Mental Health in 30 Institutions

A Supreme Court-appointed task force has visited 30 higher education institutions across 10 states to study the mental health of students. The visits, which began in May 2025, are part of the task force's efforts to prevent student suicides. The initiative aims to gather data on the mental well-being of students in educational settings.
